{{Quote|That’s okay&mdash;I’ll take us up. Where on Elegasso are you?''"<br />"''Coskone Field, northern edge of Skemp City.|Joak Quiller to Mara Jade|<ref name="Choices of One">''[[Choices of One]]''</ref>}}
'''Coskone field''' was a location on the northern edge of [[Skemp city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Elegasso]].<ref name="Choices of One" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] left her heavily modified [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar]] [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Lambda-class T-4a]] shuttle there while she set out to rescue the captured [[Hand of Judgment]], a squad of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] that had deserted the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Choices of One" />
